poc_plan: Objective: validate Dedicated runtime for production ETA chat + reranking with predictable latency and safe rollouts
Duration: 30 days (14-day canary phase + 14-day full validation)
Topology: Dedicated pool in us-east-1 primary, secondary in us-west-2 for region failover; VPC peering + private endpoints
Canary plan: start at 5% traffic -> 20% after 24h -> 50% at 48h -> 100% at 72h if metrics stable
Model variants: baseline open model (quantized 8-bit) vs higher-accuracy variant (float16) for rollback comparison
Fallback routing: automated policy to route to alternate model variant or region if p95 latency or error rate thresholds breached
Rollback criteria: >2% delta in rerank accuracy on evaluation set, p95 latency >200ms for >15min, error rate >1% sustained
Success metrics: p95 latency <150ms for short-chat flows, rerank precision lift >=8% vs current baseline, cost per 1k tokens within target range
Observability: enable token-level cost breakout, route-level tracing, and audit logs for every request during POC
Security tests: SSO/SAML sign-in flow validation, KMS-encrypted model artifacts, and infra pen-test checklist
technical_requirements: Latency target: p95 < 150ms for chat 1-5 turn flows
Throughput: sustain 200 qps peak for embedding + rerank micro-bursts
Caching: prefix/KV caching required to reduce token cost for repeated manifest lookups
Routing: policy-based routing by latency and cost, automatic fallback to region/model variant
Data controls: request/response audit logging, retention 12 months, US residency
Auth: SSO (SAML) + RBAC; customer-managed KMS for key material
Networking: VPC peering or PrivateLink; definitive CIDR ranges needed from Railgate infra
pricing_concerns: Customer requests committed Dedicated pricing for 12 months with 4-GPU pool baseline
Wants transparent burst pricing and clear overage rules; concerned about tokenized billing for reranking-heavy workloads
Requested a discounted quote if they commit to a 12-month RU (reserved units) and telemetry retention add-on
Asked for example monthly cost breakdown at 100k chats + 1M rerank ops per month
